scripts.db:update:max_locks_per_transaction: docker exec -it supabase_db_orca-revenant bash -c 'echo "max_locks_per_transaction = '128'" >> /etc/postgresql/postgresql.conf && su postgres -c "/usr/lib/postgresql/bin/pg_ctl reload"'
scripts.db:reset: supabase db reset && pnpm run db:update:max_locks_per_transaction && pnpm kysely migrate:latest --cwd ./database && pnpm kysely seed:run --cwd ./database && pnpm typegen
scripts.db:dump: docker exec supabase_db_orca-revenant pg_dump -U postgres -d postgres --data-only --rows-per-insert=1000 -f /tmp/dump.sql && docker cp supabase_db_orca-revenant:/tmp/dump.sql ./dump.sql
scripts.db:restore: docker exec -i supabase_db_orca-revenant psql -U postgres -d "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=0 < dump_price.sql
